narrative.overview: BantuKasir uses the supplied LATANSA CP01 files as the visual starting point: sidebar-led enterprise shell, compact topbar, clear hierarchy, activity/attention regions and readable operational tables. The refinement preserves that structure while using BantuKasir identity, proportional spacing and deliberate mobile reflow.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained navy/teal identity on white and cool neutral surfaces.
One humanist sans-serif family across all roles.
Dense readable operational content with generous touch targets.
Status meaning remains independent of brand color.

rules.name: Semantic Independence
rules.body: Success uses green, warning amber, danger red and information blue. Pair foreground with its matching soft background, and always include a text label or an explicit icon/shape.

rules.name: Restrained Accent
rules.body: Teal marks primary forms/filter actions; navy marks selected desktop navigation and cashier review. Semantic status colors remain independent.

rules.name: Single Family
rules.body: No separate display, mono-money or role-specific font.

dos: Do reuse this candidate system and its existing primitives; after owner approval, treat its exact visual revision as the master for BK02–BK04.
Do keep Bahasa Indonesia labels, explicit state/period/context, tabular amounts and 44px touch actions.
donts: Don't invent another visual language, token scale or page-specific button family in later bundles.
Don't treat review evidence as owner approval, or begin another BK task without authorization.
